items.question: Trong câu "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a text format for storing and exchanging data between systems.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a text format for storing and exchanging data between systems.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔː(r)/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Storing and exchanging data" = lưu trữ và trao đổi dữ liệu; danh từ "storage" = nơi lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔː(r)/ (verb): to keep for later use. "Storing and exchanging data" means keeping and sharing it; noun: storage.

items.question: Trong câu "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a text format for storing and exchanging data between systems.", từ "exchange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a text format for storing and exchanging data between systems.", what does "exchange" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (động từ): trao đổi (qua lại). "Exchanging data between systems" = trao đổi dữ liệu giữa các hệ thống; cấu trúc "exchange A with B".
items.explanationEn: exchange /ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (verb): to pass back and forth. "Exchanging data between systems" means passing it back and forth; pattern: "exchange A with B".

items.question: Trong câu "It is the most common format that APIs use to return data.", từ "common" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the most common format that APIs use to return data.", what does "common" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: common /ˈkɒmən/ (tính từ): phổ biến. "The most common format" = định dạng phổ biến nhất; "in common" = điểm chung.
items.explanationEn: common /ˈkɒmən/ (adjective): widely used. "The most common format" is the most widely used; "in common" means shared.

items.question: Trong câu "Read API results in Postman/Swagger to test a requirement.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read API results in Postman/Swagger to test a requirement.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a feature a system must have
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu (nghiệp vụ). "Test a requirement" = kiểm thử một yêu cầu; BA viết "business requirements" (yêu cầu nghiệp vụ).
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪəmənt/ (noun): a feature a system must have. "Test a requirement" means check a feature works as specified; BAs write "business requirements".

items.question: Trong câu "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", what does "map" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to link items one to one
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): ánh xạ, đối chiếu. "Map data fields between two systems" = đối chiếu trường của hệ thống này với hệ thống kia; "map A to B".
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to link items one to one. "Map data fields" means link each field in one system to one in another; pattern: "map A to B".

items.question: Trong câu "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", từ "field" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", what does "field" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: field /fiːld/ (danh từ): trường (dữ liệu). "Data fields" = các trường dữ liệu (như name, price); "in the field of" = trong lĩnh vực.
items.explanationEn: field /fiːld/ (noun): a named piece of data. "Data fields" are named items like name or price; "in the field of" means in an area of work.

items.question: Trong câu "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", từ "spec" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map data fields between two systems when writing an integration spec.", what does "spec" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spec /spek/ (danh từ): bản đặc tả. "An integration spec" = bản đặc tả tích hợp; "spec" là viết tắt của specification.
items.explanationEn: spec /spek/ (noun): a detailed requirements document. "An integration spec" is a detailed design document; "spec" is short for specification.

items.question: Trong câu "Write clear acceptance criteria", từ "acceptance criteria" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write clear acceptance criteria", what does "acceptance criteria" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: acceptance criteria /əkˈseptəns kraɪˈtɪəriə/ (cụm từ): tiêu chí nghiệm thu. "Acceptance criteria" = điều kiện để tính năng được chấp nhận; "criteria" là số nhiều của "criterion".
items.explanationEn: acceptance criteria /əkˈseptəns kraɪˈtɪəriə/ (phrase): conditions a feature must meet. "Acceptance criteria" are the conditions a feature must meet; "criteria" is the plural of "criterion".

items.question: Trong câu "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", từ "design" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", what does "design" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: design /dɪˈzaɪn/ (động từ): thiết kế (có mục đích). "Is designed to be human-readable" = được thiết kế để người đọc được; "be designed to do" = được làm ra nhằm.
items.explanationEn: design /dɪˈzaɪn/ (verb): to plan for a purpose. "Is designed to be human-readable" means made on purpose for that; pattern: "be designed to do".

items.question: Trong câu "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", từ "human-readable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", what does "human-readable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: human-readable /ˌhjuːmən ˈriːdəbl/ (tính từ): con người đọc hiểu được. "Human-readable" = người đọc hiểu được; đối lập với "machine-readable" (máy đọc được).
items.explanationEn: human-readable /ˌhjuːmən ˈriːdəbl/ (adjective): easy for people to read. "Human-readable" means people can read it; compare "machine-readable".

items.question: Trong câu "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", từ "at the same time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JSON is designed to be human-readable and machine-processable at the same time.", what does "at the same time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the same time /ət ðə seɪm taɪm/ (cụm từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "At the same time" = đồng thời; cũng dùng để nói "tuy nhiên" khi nêu ý đối lập.
items.explanationEn: at the same time /ət ðə seɪm taɪm/ (phrase): simultaneously. "At the same time" means simultaneously; it can also mean "however" in an argument.

items.question: Trong câu "A key is always a string in double quotes", từ "quote" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A key is always a string in double quotes", what does "quote" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quote /kwəʊt/ (danh từ): dấu ngoặc kép. "Double quotes" = dấu ngoặc kép ("); "single quotes" = dấu nháy đơn ('). "A quote" còn là bảng báo giá.
items.explanationEn: quote /kwəʊt/ (noun): a quotation mark. "Double quotes" are the " marks; "single quotes" are ' marks. A "quote" is also a price estimate.

items.question: Trong câu "Pairs are separated by commas", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pairs are separated by commas", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to split up as a couple
items.explanation: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (động từ): phân tách, ngăn cách. "Separated by commas" = được ngăn cách bởi dấu phẩy; tính từ /ˈseprət/ = riêng biệt.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (verb): to divide or keep apart. "Separated by commas" means divided by them; the adjective /ˈseprət/ means distinct.

items.question: Trong câu "Pairs are separated by commas", từ "comma" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pairs are separated by commas", what does "comma" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: comma /ˈkɒmə/ (danh từ): dấu phẩy. "Separated by commas" = ngăn cách bằng dấu phẩy; đừng nhầm với "coma" (hôn mê).
items.explanationEn: comma /ˈkɒmə/ (noun): the , mark. "Separated by commas" uses the , mark; do not confuse with "coma" (unconsciousness).

items.question: Trong câu "No quotes, no thousands separators", từ "separator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No quotes, no thousands separators", what does "separator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: separator /ˈsepəreɪtə(r)/ (danh từ): dấu phân cách. "Thousands separators" = dấu phân cách hàng nghìn (như 25,000); JSON không cho dùng trong số.
items.explanationEn: separator /ˈsepəreɪtə(r)/ (noun): a mark that splits values. "Thousands separators" are marks like the commas in 25,000; JSON numbers cannot use them.

items.question: Trong câu "These are the two most important building blocks — telling them apart means you understand 90% of JSON.", từ "building block" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are the two most important building blocks — telling them apart means you understand 90% of JSON.", what does "building block" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (cụm từ): thành phần cơ bản. "Building blocks" = các khối cơ bản để tạo nên cái lớn hơn; nghĩa đen là khối gỗ xếp hình.
items.explanationEn: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (phrase): a basic component. "Building blocks" are the basic parts things are made from; literally, toy bricks.

items.question: Trong câu "These are the two most important building blocks — telling them apart means you understand 90% of JSON.", từ "tell apart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are the two most important building blocks — telling them apart means you understand 90% of JSON.", what does "tell apart" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): phân biệt. "Telling them apart" = phân biệt chúng; cấu trúc "tell A and B apart" hoặc "tell A from B".
items.explanationEn: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to see the difference. "Telling them apart" means seeing the difference; also "tell A from B".

items.question: Trong câu "an object made of several key–value pairs", từ "made of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an object made of several key–value pairs", what does "made of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: made of /meɪd əv/ (cụm từ): được tạo thành từ. "An object made of several key–value pairs" = đối tượng gồm nhiều cặp khóa–giá trị; "made of wood" = làm bằng gỗ.
items.explanationEn: made of /meɪd əv/ (phrase): consisting of. "An object made of several pairs" means consisting of them; compare "made of wood".

items.question: Trong câu "an object made of several key–value pairs", từ "several" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an object made of several key–value pairs", what does "several" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: several /ˈsevrəl/ (tính từ): vài, một số. "Several key–value pairs" = một vài cặp khóa–giá trị; "several" dùng với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.
items.explanationEn: several /ˈsevrəl/ (adjective): more than two, not many. "Several key–value pairs" means a few; use it with plural countable nouns.

items.question: Trong câu "an object made of several key–value pairs", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an object made of several key–value pairs", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pair /peə(r)/ (danh từ): cặp. "Key–value pairs" = các cặp khóa–giá trị; "in pairs" = theo từng cặp.
items.explanationEn: pair /peə(r)/ (noun): a set of two. "Key–value pairs" are sets of a key and a value; "in pairs" means two at a time.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: a list of tags.", từ "tag" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: a list of tags.", what does "tag" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tag /tæɡ/ (danh từ): nhãn, thẻ phân loại. "A list of tags" = danh sách nhãn phân loại; động từ "tag a photo" = gắn thẻ ảnh.
items.explanationEn: tag /tæɡ/ (noun): a label for grouping. "A list of tags" is a set of labels; the verb "tag a photo" means label it.

items.question: Trong câu "Here tags is an array containing 3 strings.", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here tags is an array containing 3 strings.", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa. "An array containing 3 strings" = mảng chứa 3 chuỗi; "contain your anger" = kiềm chế cơn giận.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "An array containing 3 strings" has them inside; "contain your anger" means hold it back.

items.question: Trong câu "Here tags is an array containing 3 strings.", từ "string" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here tags is an array containing 3 strings.", what does "string" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: string /strɪŋ/ (danh từ): chuỗi ký tự. "3 strings" = 3 chuỗi ký tự; nghĩa đời thường là sợi dây. "Chuỗi cửa hàng" là "chain", không phải "string".
items.explanationEn: string /strɪŋ/ (noun): a piece of text. "3 strings" are pieces of text; in daily English a string is a thin cord.

items.question: Trong câu "A value can itself be an object.", từ "itself" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A value can itself be an object.", what does "itself" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: itself /ɪtˈself/ (trạng từ): chính nó. "A value can itself be an object" = bản thân giá trị cũng có thể là đối tượng; "by itself" = tự nó.
items.explanationEn: itself /ɪtˈself/ (adverb): that very thing. "A value can itself be an object" stresses the value; "by itself" means alone.

items.question: Trong câu "This is called a nested object (associative array).", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is called a nested object (associative array).", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "A nested object" = đối tượng lồng trong đối tượng khác; "nested loop" = vòng lặp lồng nhau.
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (adjective): placed inside another. "A nested object" sits inside another; compare "nested loop".

items.question: Trong câu "This is called a nested object (associative array).", từ "associative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is called a nested object (associative array).", what does "associative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: associative /əˈsəʊʃiətɪv/ (tính từ): liên kết (khóa với giá trị). "Associative array" = mảng liên kết, truy cập theo khóa thay vì số thứ tự; động từ: associate.
items.explanationEn: associative /əˈsəʊʃiətɪv/ (adjective): linking keys to values. "Associative array" is looked up by key, not index; verb: associate.

items.question: Trong câu "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", từ "single" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", what does "single" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: single /ˈsɪŋɡl/ (tính từ): đơn lẻ, duy nhất. "Not a single value" = không phải một giá trị đơn lẻ; "single" còn là độc thân.
items.explanationEn: single /ˈsɪŋɡl/ (adjective): just one. "Not a single value" means not just one value; "single" also means not married.

items.question: Trong câu "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", từ "child" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", what does "child" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: child /tʃaɪld/ (tính từ): con (nằm bên trong cấp cha). "A child object" = đối tượng con nằm trong đối tượng cha (parent); "parent–child" rất hay gặp trong IT.
items.explanationEn: child /tʃaɪld/ (adjective): nested under a parent. "A child object" sits under a parent object; "parent–child" is a common IT pair.

items.question: Trong câu "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): chứa, giữ (dữ liệu). "Holding detailed information" = chứa thông tin chi tiết; "hold a meeting" = tổ chức họp.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to contain or keep. "Holding detailed information" means containing it; "hold a meeting" means organise one.

items.question: Trong câu "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", từ "detailed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "specs is not a single value — it is a child object holding detailed information.", what does "detailed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: detailed /ˈdiːteɪld/ (tính từ): chi tiết. "Detailed information" = thông tin chi tiết; danh từ: detail, "in detail" = một cách chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: detailed /ˈdiːteɪld/ (adjective): with many specifics. "Detailed information" has many specifics; noun: detail; "in detail" means thoroughly.

items.question: Trong câu "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", từ "extremely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", what does "extremely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: extremely /ɪkˈstriːmli/ (trạng từ): cực kỳ. "An extremely common case" = trường hợp cực kỳ phổ biến; tính từ: extreme.
items.explanationEn: extremely /ɪkˈstriːmli/ (adverb): very much. "An extremely common case" is very common indeed; adjective: extreme.

items.question: Trong câu "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", từ "record" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", what does "record" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: record /ˈrekɔːd/ (danh từ): bản ghi (một dòng dữ liệu). "Each object is one record" = mỗi đối tượng là một bản ghi; "break a record" = phá kỷ lục.
items.explanationEn: record /ˈrekɔːd/ (noun): one entry of data. "Each object is one record" means one data entry; "break a record" means beat the best.

items.question: Trong câu "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", từ "row" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An extremely common case in API responses: an array containing several objects, where each object is one record (like a row in a data table).", what does "row" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: row /rəʊ/ (danh từ): hàng, dòng (bảng). "A row in a data table" = một dòng trong bảng; "in a row" = liên tiếp. Phát âm /raʊ/ thì là cãi vã.
items.explanationEn: row /rəʊ/ (noun): a horizontal line of cells. "A row in a data table" is a horizontal line; "in a row" means consecutively.

items.question: Trong câu "Each element has the same set of keys.", từ "element" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each element has the same set of keys.", what does "element" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: element /ˈelɪmənt/ (danh từ): phần tử. "Each element" = mỗi phần tử trong mảng; "a key element" = yếu tố then chốt.
items.explanationEn: element /ˈelɪmənt/ (noun): one item in a list. "Each element" is one item in the array; "a key element" is an important factor.

items.question: Trong câu "they are pointing out a path through the JSON", từ "point out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they are pointing out a path through the JSON", what does "point out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point out /pɔɪnt aʊt/ (cụm từ): chỉ ra. "Pointing out a path" = chỉ ra một đường dẫn; "point out a mistake" = chỉ ra lỗi.
items.explanationEn: point out /pɔɪnt aʊt/ (phrase): to show or indicate. "Pointing out a path" means indicating it; "point out a mistake" is a common use.

items.question: Trong câu "they are pointing out a path through the JSON", từ "path" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they are pointing out a path through the JSON", what does "path" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: path /pɑːθ/ (danh từ): đường dẫn (tới giá trị). "A path through the JSON" = đường dẫn tới giá trị, như customer.name; "file path" = đường dẫn tệp.
items.explanationEn: path /pɑːθ/ (noun): a route to a value. "A path through the JSON" is a route such as customer.name; compare "file path".

items.question: Trong câu "Arrays are numbered from 0, so the first element is items[0], not items[1].", từ "number" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arrays are numbered from 0, so the first element is items[0], not items[1].", what does "number" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give each item a number
items.explanation: number /ˈnʌmbə(r)/ (động từ): đánh số. "Arrays are numbered from 0" = mảng được đánh số từ 0; "number in the thousands" = lên tới hàng nghìn.
items.explanationEn: number /ˈnʌmbə(r)/ (verb): to give each item a number. "Arrays are numbered from 0" means indexing starts at zero; "number in the thousands" means amount to.

items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless set otherwise. "Return JSON by default" means unless told otherwise; "win by default" means the rival did not show.

items.question: Trong câu "APIs use the header Content-Type: application/json to say the body data is JSON.", từ "header" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: header /ˈhedə(r)/ (noun): metadata sent with a request. "The header Content-Type" is metadata saying the data type; compare "request headers".

items.question: Trong câu "APIs use the header Content-Type: application/json to say the body data is JSON.", từ "body" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: body /ˈbɒdi/ (noun): the main data part. "The body data" is the main content of the request; "governing body" is an organisation.

items.question: Trong câu "The client uses Accept: application/json to request that the server respond with JSON.", từ "request" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: request /rɪˈkwest/ (verb): to ask for formally. "Request that the server respond" uses the base verb after "request that".

items.explanationEn: agree on /əˈɡriː ɒn/ (phrase): to reach a shared decision. "Agree on the format" means settle it together; "agree with someone" means share their view.

items.explanationEn: mapping /ˈmæpɪŋ/ (noun): a link between two sets of fields. "A mapping table" links fields of two systems; verb: map A to B.
